svg.title: G05 ARES CREW RESOURCE VAULT engineering architecture
svg.desc: Production and qualified availability are separated by an evidence gate. Imported reserve, coupled outage/rejection and mission-specific equivalence factors remain explicit; human-use quality is not inferred from gross oxygen output.
